method.backward_euler_frequency_mapping: s_BE=(1-exp(-j*2*pi*f*dt))/dt; the discrete response equals the continuous resolvent evaluated at s_BE
method.discrete_input: 10-pA rectangular sequence; sample interval 0.00625 ms; onset 2 ms; widths 2 and 10 ms; DFT is taken over each exact observation window
method.finite_record_identity: (G+(1-exp(-j*Omega))*C/dt) X = B U - (C/dt)*x[N-1]; the terminal state is included explicitly, not discarded
method.sample_and_hold: u[n] is held constant on [n*dt,(n+1)*dt); x[n] is the state at the end of that interval; continuous comparator uses the exact zero-order-hold Fourier factor dt*sinc(f*dt)*exp(-j*pi*f*dt)

scientific_limits: The discrete transfer is exact for the declared backward-Euler state update and sample/hold convention.
The continuous AC comparator is sampled on finite-record DFT bins and weighted by the ZOH input spectrum; it is not the exact sampled response of the continuous-time differential equation.
The transfer-only H_BE*U term is a periodic/circular record component; the terminal-state correction is required for a finite record initialized at rest.
Four individual passive linear-RC morphology reconstructions are compared; they are not populations. Control, mouse and epilepsy-surgical source conditions remain separately identified.
Large relative transfer-error ratios can occur when the seven-port denominator is extremely small; absolute weighted norms and finite transient NRMSE are retained.
Full Hines remains canonical. No production solver code or defaults are changed.
No active-neuron, synaptic, plasticity or biological validation is claimed.

validation.full_hines_identity_coordinates: The DFT identity uses a second mathematically equivalent full-Hines replay in perturbation coordinates (zero initial perturbation, zero leak source). The canonical absolute-voltage replay is retained for transient NRMSE, and its difference from perturbation coordinates is recorded separately.
validation.identity_normalization: output DFT L2 norm; finite-error identity is not divided by the much smaller inter-model residual norm
validation.transient_metric_note: The canonical absolute-voltage transient NRMSE is retained for historical continuity. The perturbation-coordinate transient NRMSE is also reported and is the numerically stable comparison for these small passive residuals; the absolute-vs-perturbation trace delta is recorded per case.
